exposure: conservative management (methotrexate injection, uterine artery embolisation)
cohort: A 24-year-old pregnant woman with a history of previous caesarean section presented with a Caesarean Scar Pregnancy at eight weeks gestation.
finding: Conservative management, including methotrexate injection and uterine artery embolisation, was successful in resolving Caesarean Scar Pregnancy and normalizing beta-hCG levels, even with extremely high initial beta-hCG.
